description: Export a single layer's features as a downloadable file. Returns a URL with Content-Disposition: attachment so the user's browser downloads it. CSV drops geometry beyond a (lng, lat) centroid — for full polygon/line geometry, use format: "geojson". The URL is an unguessable capability link that does NOT expire: anyone with the link can download the file. Required: map_id, layer_id, format.

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: export_layer_data
title: Export layer data
